sections.heading: Python API¶
sections.text:
readio.api exposes a small orchestration service and management functions that delegate to specialist package-root APIs. Specialist results are returned unchanged; Readio does not mirror their option schemas or translate their exceptions.

from pathlib import Path
from readio.api import (
    BookExportRequest,
    CreateWorkspaceRequest,
    ComposeRequest,
    PlanRequest,
    Readio,
    RenderPlanRequest,
    RunRequest,
    VoiceRenderRequest,
)
sections.lower:
readio.api exposes a small orchestration service and management functions that delegate to specialist package-root apis. specialist results are returned unchanged; readio does not mirror their option schemas or translate their exceptions.

from pathlib import path
from readio.api import (
    bookexportrequest,
    createworkspacerequest,
    composerequest,
    planrequest,
    readio,
    renderplanrequest,
    runrequest,
    voicerenderrequest,
)

sections.heading: Workspace lifecycle¶
sections.text:
Readio.create_workspace(source, request=None) converts source material through SSMDConvert and returns an immutable WorkspaceRef. EPUB input defaults to a .ssmdbook; other supported input defaults to .ssmdoc. Readio.resolve_workspace(path) validates and loads an existing native workspace. No Readio project registry or migration is involved.

service = Readio()
workspace = service.create_workspace("article.txt")
assert workspace.root.suffix == ".ssmdoc"




Use CreateWorkspaceRequest to select kind, output path, language, chapter range, or force behavior. Its source must match the source argument.

sections.heading: Planning and pipeline sequencing¶
sections.text:
Readio.plan(workspace, PlanRequest(...)) delegates semantic compilation to UtterPlan. Readio.render_plan(workspace, RenderPlanRequest(profile=...)) returns RenderPlanResult(native, variant). The variant is the exact value returned by UtterPlan.

Readio.render, Readio.compose, and Readio.export dispatch by workspace kind to VoiceRender, AudioCompose, and AudioExport. Requests contain Readio routing fields and specialist-native option values; artifacts and reports remain package-owned.

Readio.run(source_or_workspace, RunRequest(...)) performs workspace creation/resolution, planning, projection, rendering, composition, and optional export. It replaces downstream request variants with the exact projected variant before dispatch:

result = service…

readio.plan(workspace, planrequest(...)) delegates semantic compilation to utterplan. readio.render_plan(workspace, renderplanrequest(profile=...)) returns renderplanresult(native, variant). the variant is the exact value returned by utterplan.

sections.heading: Book operations¶
sections.text:
Readio.create_workspace() converts EPUB input into a native .ssmdbook; CreateWorkspaceRequest can select chapters and conversion language. PlanRequest, RenderPlanRequest, VoiceRenderRequest, and ComposeRequest carry book chapter selectors to the corresponding specialists. Use BookExportRequest when requesting book export through the Python service.

Store a book’s RenderProfile inside its workspace so UtterPlan can record a workspace-relative provenance reference during projection.

sections.heading: Direct speech¶
sections.text: readio.api.speak(text, ...) synthesizes literal text through VoiceRender and plays it locally unless no_play=True. It accepts a voice selector or a saved RenderProfile and role, and can save WAV output. It does not create a workspace or invoke UtterPlan, AudioCompose, or AudioExport.
sections.lower: readio.api.speak(text, ...) synthesizes literal text through voicerender and plays it locally unless no_play=true. it accepts a voice selector or a saved renderprofile and role, and can save wav output. it does not create a workspace or invoke utterplan, audiocompose, or audioexport.

sections.heading: VoiceRender management¶
sections.text: readio.api provides thin delegates for engine/model discovery and management, voice discovery and source/clone operations, selector parsing, and RenderProfile creation, validation, refresh, and role management. Calls use VoiceRender’s public package-root API and preserve its result objects and validation behavior. Readio does not provide voice design or an engine implementation.
sections.lower: readio.api provides thin delegates for engine/model discovery and management, voice discovery and source/clone operations, selector parsing, and renderprofile creation, validation, refresh, and role management. calls use voicerender’s public package-root api and preserve its result objects and validation behavior. readio does not provide voice design or an engine implementation.

sections.heading: Compatibility policy¶
sections.text: Version 0.5 is a clean break. Readio-owned project directories, settings, plans, manifests, and old stage APIs are unsupported. There is no migration, compatibility alias, or hidden state attachment. Use SSMDConvert to create native .ssmdoc/.ssmdbook workspaces from source material, or use the specialist packages directly.

sections.heading: Readio architecture¶
sections.text: Readio is a thin orchestration layer over specialist public APIs. Each specialist package owns its domain schemas, validation, persisted artifacts, reports, and reuse rules. Readio owns workspace routing, request sequencing, CLI convenience, and small in-memory event/result adapters.
sections.lower: readio is a thin orchestration layer over specialist public apis. each specialist package owns its domain schemas, validation, persisted artifacts, reports, and reuse rules. readio owns workspace routing, request sequencing, cli convenience, and small in-memory event/result adapters.

sections.heading: Document workspaces¶
sections.text:
source document
  → SSMDConvert: convert to native .ssmdoc
  → UtterPlan: compile semantic speech plan
  → UtterPlan / RenderPlan: project a profile-specific variant
  → VoiceRender: preflight and synthesize
  → AudioCompose: compose WAV output
  → AudioExport: optionally encode a delivery format
sections.lower:
source document
  → ssmdconvert: convert to native .ssmdoc
  → utterplan: compile semantic speech plan
  → utterplan / renderplan: project a profile-specific variant
  → voicerender: preflight and synthesize
  → audiocompose: compose wav output
  → audioexport: optionally encode a delivery format

sections.heading: Book workspaces¶
sections.text:
EPUB
  → SSMDConvert: convert to native .ssmdbook
  → UtterPlan: compile chapters and project a variant
  → VoiceRender: render selected chapters
  → AudioCompose: compose book audio and chapter timeline
  → AudioExport: optionally encode the book




readio run sequences the stages for either workspace kind. Its RenderPlan result supplies the exact variant sent to VoiceRender, AudioCompose, and AudioExport. The manual CLI and Python service expose the same specialist stages for workflows that need stage-by-stage control. Readio does not normalize or reconstruct the variant.

sections.heading: Manual specialist workflow¶
sections.text:
Use specialist CLIs directly when package-specific controls or detailed diagnostics are needed. Preserve the exact variant returned by UtterPlan:

ssmdconvert book convert novel.epub -o novel.ssmdbook
utterplan compile-book novel.ssmdbook
voicerender profile create --engine kokoro --target v1.0 --voice af_heart \
  --language en-US -o novel.ssmdbook/narrator.renderprofile.toml
utterplan render-book novel.ssmdbook \
  --profile novel.ssmdbook/narrator.renderprofile.toml

VARIANT="<exact variant returned by utterplan render-book>"
voicerender render-book novel.ssmdbook --variant "$VARIANT"
audiocompose compose-book novel.ssmdbook --variant "$VARIANT"
audioexport export-book novel.ssmdbook --variant "$VARIANT" --output novel.m4b

sections.heading: Persistent state and compatibility¶
sections.text:
.ssmdoc and .ssmdbook bundles and all stage artifacts remain specialist-owned. Readio writes no parallel project state, project manifest, stage status, RenderPlan, render manifest, composition job, or export format. Its WorkspaceRef, progress events, and pipeline results are in-memory routing/adaptation values only.

Version 0.5 is a clean break from Readio’s former project and pipeline formats. Old Readio project directories and settings are unsupported and are not read or attached. There is no migration command, compatibility alias, or runtime shim. Recreate work from source material with SSMDConvert, or use the specialist packages directly.
sections.lower:
.ssmdoc and .ssmdbook bundles and all stage artifacts remain specialist-owned. readio writes no parallel project state, project manifest, stage status, renderplan, render manifest, composition job, or export format. its workspaceref, progress events, and pipeline results are in-memory routing/adaptation values only.

version 0.5 is a clean break from readio’s former project and pipeline formats. old readio project directories and settings are unsupported and are not read or attached. there is no migration command, compatibility alias, or runtime shim. recreate work from source material with ssmdconvert, or use the specialist packages directly.

sections.heading: Dependency boundary¶
sections.text: Readio imports specialist package-root public APIs only: SSMDConvert, UtterPlan, VoiceRender, AudioCompose, and optional AudioExport. It does not import specialist private submodules or backend SDKs. The dependency-boundary tests enforce this rule and guard against reintroducing legacy persistence identifiers. Playback and audio I/O helpers unrelated to workspace stages remain in Readio.
sections.lower: readio imports specialist package-root public apis only: ssmdconvert, utterplan, voicerender, audiocompose, and optional audioexport. it does not import specialist private submodules or backend sdks. the dependency-boundary tests enforce this rule and guard against reintroducing legacy persistence identifiers. playback and audio i/o helpers unrelated to workspace stages remain in readio.

sections.heading: CLI reference¶
sections.text:
Readio’s CLI creates or resolves native .ssmdoc and .ssmdbook workspaces and dispatches each stage to its owning specialist package. Use readio --help and command-specific help for the installed option set.

readio --help
readio init --help
readio plan --help
readio render-plan --help
readio run --help
readio speak --help
readio doctor --help
sections.lower:
readio’s cli creates or resolves native .ssmdoc and .ssmdbook workspaces and dispatches each stage to its owning specialist package. use readio --help and command-specific help for the installed option set.

readio plan --help
readio render-plan --help
readio run --help

sections.heading: Create and plan¶
sections.text:
readio init article.docx -o article.ssmdoc
readio plan article.ssmdoc --language en-US
readio init novel.epub -o novel.ssmdbook
readio plan novel.ssmdbook --language en-US --chapters 5-17




init delegates conversion and bundle writing to SSMDConvert. It infers EPUB as a book and other supported inputs as documents unless --kind is supplied. Outputs use the matching .ssmdoc or .ssmdbook suffix. plan delegates compilation to UtterPlan; its planner options include language, diagnostics, text preparation, overlap/renderability policy, and optional spaCy controls.

init delegates conversion and bundle writing to ssmdconvert. it infers epub as a book and other supported inputs as documents unless --kind is supplied. outputs use the matching .ssmdoc or .ssmdbook suffix. plan delegates compilation to utterplan; its planner options include language, diagnostics, text preparation, overlap/renderability policy, and optional spacy controls.

sections.heading: Manual specialist workflow¶
sections.text:
readio render-plan article.ssmdoc --profile narrator.renderprofile.toml --json
VARIANT="<exact variant returned by render-plan>"
readio render article.ssmdoc --variant "$VARIANT"
readio compose article.ssmdoc --variant "$VARIANT"
readio export article.ssmdoc --variant "$VARIANT" --output article.m4a




render-plan delegates profile-specific projection to UtterPlan and emits the specialist variant. When running stages manually, pass that exact variant unchanged to render, compose, and export. render delegates to VoiceRender; compose to AudioCompose; export to AudioExport. The export stage requires the optional AudioExport integration (install readio[audioexport]).

sections.heading: Run the complete pipeline¶
sections.text:
readio run article.docx --profile narrator.renderprofile.toml \
  --language en-US --json
readio run novel.ssmdbook \
  --profile novel.ssmdbook/narrator.renderprofile.toml \
  --chapters 5-17 --language en-US --export --output novel.m4b




run can accept source material or an existing workspace. It creates/resolves the native workspace, compiles, projects the RenderPlan, renders, and composes. --export adds the optional export stage. Readio forwards UtterPlan’s projected variant unchanged across all downstream calls. Stage-specific roots, policies, force flags, chapter selection, metadata, and encoder paths are forwarded to specialist APIs rather than reimplemented.

  --language en-us --json

  --profile novel.ssmdbook/narrator.renderprofile.toml \
  --chapters 5-17 --language en-us --export --output novel.m4b




run can accept source material or an existing workspace. it creates/resolves the native workspace, compiles, projects the renderplan, renders, and composes. --export adds the optional export stage. readio forwards utterplan’s projected variant unchanged across all downstream calls. stage-specific roots, policies, force flags, chapter selection, metadata, and encoder paths are forwarded to specialist apis rather than reimplemented.

sections.heading: Voice and profile management¶
sections.text:
These command groups delegate to VoiceRender:


engines and models discover, inspect, install, verify, and remove engine models.


voices discovers voices; voice source creates and inspects voice-source artifacts; voice clone creates a specialist RenderProfile.


profile creates, inspects, validates, refreshes, and manages RenderProfile roles.



Use the command-specific --help output for selectors and options. Install engine backends through VoiceRender extras, for example python -m pip install "voicerender[kokoro]".
sections.lower:
these command groups delegate to voicerender:


engines and models discover, inspect, install, verify, and remove engine models.


voices discovers voices; voice source creates and inspects voice-source artifacts; voice clone creates a specialist renderprofile.


profile creates, inspects, validates, refreshes, and manages renderprofile roles.



use the command-specific --help output for selectors and options. install engine backends through voicerender extras, for example python -m pip install "voicerender[kokoro]".

sections.heading: Direct speech¶
sections.text:
readio speak --voice kokoro:v1.0/af_heart --lang en-US "Hello."
readio speak --profile narrator.renderprofile.toml --role narrator \
  --output greeting.wav --no-play "Hello."




speak synthesizes literal text through VoiceRender and plays by default. --output writes WAV and --no-play skips local playback. Use --json for a machine-readable result.

sections.heading: Dependency diagnostics¶
sections.text:
readio doctor
readio doctor --json




Doctor reports specialist package versions and VoiceRender engine availability. Progress is written to stderr; JSON results and structured errors are written to stdout. --no-progress disables progress callbacks on workflows that support them.

sections.heading: Removed commands¶
sections.text: The current CLI has no config, audiobook, or former generic project/plan/render-manifest command groups. Readio does not read a readio.toml or .readio state, and provides no migration path for its former project format. Use readio init to create a new native workspace from source material, or use the specialist packages directly.

sections.heading: Specialist workflow¶
sections.text:
The package-owned stages are:

SSMDConvert → UtterPlan / RenderPlan → VoiceRender → AudioCompose → AudioExport




Start with the architecture guide, use the CLI reference for Readio commands, and see the Python API guide for service calls. Consult each specialist package for complete package-specific options.
sections.lower:
the package-owned stages are:

ssmdconvert → utterplan / renderplan → voicerender → audiocompose → audioexport




start with the architecture guide, use the cli reference for readio commands, and see the python api guide for service calls. consult each specialist package for complete package-specific options.

sections.heading: Installation¶
sections.text: Readio requires Python 3.10 or newer. Install it with python -m pip install readio, then install a speech engine through VoiceRender, for example python -m pip install "readio[kokoro]". The optional readio[documents], readio[spacy], and readio[audioexport] extras enable document formats, UtterPlan spaCy support, and AudioExport respectively.

sections.heading: Readio commands¶
sections.text:
readio init story.txt -o story.ssmdoc
readio run story.ssmdoc --profile narrator.renderprofile.toml --language en-US
readio speak --voice kokoro:v1.0/af_heart --lang en-US "Hello."
readio doctor --json




The pipeline commands operate on .ssmdoc and .ssmdbook bundles. Readio writes no parallel project state; stage outputs remain owned by the specialist packages.

sections.heading: No legacy migration¶
sections.text: Version 0.5 deliberately removes Readio-owned projects, settings, plans, manifests, and stage records. There is no migration command or compatibility layer. Recreate work from source material with readio init, or continue with the specialist packages directly.
